cases.interpretation: I_eff=1+armature. Armature changes rotational generalized inertia while body mass and physical inertia remain fixed; it is not damping. With constant 1Nm, a=1/I_eff, v_n=n*h/I_eff, q_n=h*h*n*(n+1)/(2*I_eff).

cases.interpretation: Compute free-flight q_n=h²*n*(n+1)/2; expected activation force_t is first pre-step n with q_n>=upper. Actual first force_t with abs(qfrc_constraint)>1e-6 must match within .006s. Compare q/v to free-flight only through that first activation input state. Tail is last250steps (.5s): external+constraint=0, small speed, plateau near specified range. Shift of plateau follows .1rad range change. Do not claim exact transient soft-limit force or zero penetration.
